entry.author: West Coast Regional Council
entry.summary:
The West Coast Emergency Management Team, in conjunction with Resilient Westport, held a free public event on 23 April 2026 at the NBS Theatre in Westport to talk through elements of the Westport Evacuation Plan with the local community. 

This video sums up some of the information shared, including what to expect during an emergency, the phases of an evacuation and what residents can do to prepare. 
‍
The Westport Get Ready – Go! Evacuation Guide was also made available to help with relevant tips and information: https://www.resilientwestport.co.nz/westport-evacuation-guide
